description: This file defines the Payment class in the package com.salesmanager.core.business.payments.model, representing payment details such as payment type, transaction type, module name, and currency.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: A model class representing a payment, including payment type, transaction type, associated module name, and currency.

methods.name: setTransactionType
methods.description: Sets the transaction type, defaulting to AUTHORIZED CAPTURE.

methods.name: setModuleName
methods.description: Sets the name of the module related to this payment.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency associated with the payment.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency associated with the payment.
